name: Nanaze Izumi
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend and neighbor whom he admires, while Izumi loves him. She's the perfect yamato nadeshiko type: obedient, good at household chores and kind to everyone. Izumi's grades are also as good as Saki's. The only thing she's worried about is that she's not getting along with her little sister like she would like to.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=729464&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
